newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Binani wins bid for two Zambian mines.
newsitem.headline: Binani wins bid for two Zambian mines.

text.p: Zambia's Consolidated Copper Mines said on Monday that Binani Industries Ltd had won the bid for the company's Launshya and Baluba mines.

"The chairman of ZCCM...is pleased to announce that following the recent international tender for the sale of ZCCM assets, the Binani Group has been selected as the winning bidder for ZCCM's Launshya and Baluba mining and metallurgical complex, excluding the precious metals plant," a company official said.
Binani was among six bidders shortlisted by the Zambia Privatisation Agency for final negotiations on the sale of ZCCM assets.
